title: 第5章 蠢货第6章 你快进来
content_zh:
第5章蠢货酒楼之中，众人的心皆颤动了下，白念冰相邀，萧沉竟然拒绝了！
且不说白家的地位，光看白念冰的美貌，就没有人会对她说“不”
字吧？
白念冰也不多言，她知道萧沉并不信任她，因此，她走到了焮儿的面前，牵起了她的手，“姐姐家里有很多好吃的，你愿意和哥哥一起来吗？”
“真的吗？”
焮儿眼前一亮，随即又黯淡下来，“姐姐不会骗我吧？？”
显然，在经历了周凌雪的事情后，焮儿心里也有了阴影，对他人产生了强烈的戒备心。
“你要怎么才能相信姐姐呢？”
白念冰的笑容如同春风般，让人感到舒服和温暖。
“除非……”
焮儿像是很认真地思考了一阵子，看向了白念冰，“除非姐姐做我的嫂子。”
“咳咳！”
萧沉忍不住咳嗽了下，打断焮儿，这丫头，在瞎说什么呢。
白念冰如雪的脸上也多了一抹红晕，萧沉本就英俊，虽说修为尽失，但此刻身上却有一股神秘的气质，让她心生好奇。
“现在说这些还太早了。”
白念冰的话让周围的人露出异样之色，这是，在暗示什么吗？
随后，白念冰又走到了萧沉的身边，贴近了他的耳朵。
这略显暧昧的一幕，更让众人诧异。
“我爹收到消息，皇城王家天骄王天钦，将会迎娶周凌雪，就在远风城大比之日提亲。
届时，周凌雪将以先天道体无敌之姿，夺取大比第一，进入祁天学府，而远风城所有的矿脉资源，也将落入周家之手。

白家，不希望周府独尊远风城，我相信，萧兄也不希望看到这一幕。”
白念冰轻声说道。
“你不担心我和周家说的那样，是因轻薄周凌雪才被逐出吗？”
萧沉转过头，白念冰就在他的身侧，两人近在咫尺，四目相对。
白念冰的心跳似有些加快，但还是笑着道，“周家一面之词，岂可尽信？当然，除了家族利益外，我还有一点私心，想请萧兄帮一个忙。
不过，这个忙，要等萧兄到了白家才能说。”
“我答应。”
萧沉没有再犹豫，“我只有一个条件，我妹妹的饮食起居……”
“我会派人专门伺候的。”
白念冰热情摆手，“萧兄，请！”
白家兄妹和萧沉兄妹离去，酒楼内的事情很快传开，周家震怒，萧沉是他们周家公开追杀之人，白家竟邀请他前往。
“竟拉拢一个废人，白家，气数已尽。”
content_en:
Chapter 5 In the idiot restaurant, everyone's hearts trembled. Bai Nianbing invited him, but Xiao Chen actually refused!
Not to mention the status of the Bai family, no one would say "no" to Bai Nianbing just by looking at her beauty.
Words?
Bai Nianbing didn't say much. She knew that Xiao Chen didn't trust her, so she walked up to Yan'er and held her hand. "Sister, there are a lot of delicious food at home. Are you willing to come with brother?"
"Really?"
Yan'er's eyes lit up, then dimmed again, "Sister, you won't lie to me, right??"
Obviously, after experiencing Zhou Lingxue's incident, Yan'er also had a shadow in her heart and became strongly wary of others.
"How can you trust your sister?"
Bai Nianbing's smile was like a spring breeze, making people feel comfortable and warm.
"Unless..."
Yan'er seemed to think seriously for a while and looked at Bai Nianbing, "Unless my sister becomes my sister-in-law."
"Ahem!"
Xiao Chen couldn't help coughing and interrupted Yan'er. What is this girl talking about?
There was also a blush on Bai Nian Bing Ruxue's face. Xiao Chen was already handsome. Although he had lost all his cultivation, he had a mysterious aura about him at this moment, which made her curious.
"It's too early to say that."
Bai Nianbing's words made the people around him look strange. Is this hinting at something?
Then, Bai Nianbing walked to Xiao Chen's side and leaned close to his ear.
This slightly ambiguous scene surprised everyone even more.
"My father received the news that Wang Tianqin, the genius of the Wang family in the Imperial City, will marry Zhou Lingxue, and he will propose marriage on the day of the competition in Yuanfeng City.
By then, Zhou Lingxue will win the first place in the competition with her invincible Taoist body and enter Qitian Academy, and all the mineral resources in Yuanfeng City will also fall into the hands of the Zhou family.
The Bai family doesn't want the Zhou family to dominate Yuanfeng City, and I believe Brother Xiao doesn't want to see this either. "
Bai Nianbing said softly.
"Aren't you worried that as I said to the Zhou family, Zhou Lingxue was expelled because she was frivolous?"
Xiao Chen turned his head, and Bai Nianbing was beside him. The two of them were close at hand, their eyes facing each other.
Bai Nianbing's heartbeat seemed to be a little faster, but he still smiled and said, "How can we trust the Zhou family's words? Of course, in addition to family interests, I also have some selfish motives and want to ask Brother Xiao for a favor.
However, this can only be done after Brother Xiao arrives at the Bai family. "
"I promise."
Xiao Chen did not hesitate anymore, "I only have one condition, my sister's diet and daily life..."
"I will send someone to take care of you."
Bai Nianbing waved enthusiastically, "Brother Xiao, please!"
The Bai family brother and sister and Xiao Chen brother and sister left, and what happened in the restaurant quickly spread. The Zhou family was furious. Xiao Chen was the person that the Zhou family was openly hunting for, and the Bai family actually invited him there.
"To win over a loser, the Bai family is exhausted."
